metadata.description: Field-level permissions for published programs. This configuration determines which fields can be edited after a program is published.
notes: Fields marked as 'editable' can be modified even after program is published
Fields marked as 'readonly' are disabled when program status is 'published'
Conditions apply additional business logic (e.g., 'notPassed' for date validation)
This configuration can be used by both frontend and backend for consistent validation
